ruleName: Penalty area – Ball out of bounds or lost
title: Ball from penalty area goes out of bounds
question: You play a shot from a penalty area and your ball ends up out of bounds. Which options do you have for your next shot, following the rules?

choices.text: Drop a ball with one penalty stroke near where you played your last shot in the penalty area
Take another one-stroke penalty and use the penalty area relief options
Take a free drop from where the ball went out of bounds
Replay the shot with no penalty

explanation: If your ball from a penalty area goes out of bounds, you can either drop with a one-stroke penalty near your previous spot in the penalty area, or with another one-stroke penalty, use the normal relief options for a penalty area.
